title: Application start
description: Measure process spawn to a correctly painted, trusted-input-ready 1 MiB historical coding session. New state uses a freshly created application data directory; initialized state uses an app data directory produced only by the benchmark preparation step and never launched before the timed start.

metrics.description: Elapsed monotonic time immediately before process spawn until content identity, first-fold paint, two presentations, and trusted-input evidence are complete.
